raw_text: BREAKING: PDF forces launched coordinated attacks on SAC outposts in Sagaing Region near Indian border. At least 3 junta positions overrun near Tamu. Heavy fighting reported along the Chindwin River corridor. Civilians fleeing towards Manipur border crossings. Resistance fighters claiming significant territorial gains.
